contextes.s1: Without Wi-Fi or with a limited connection

emploiDuTemps.s1: In the app, the last week you viewed stays readable offline, with the time it was saved. The app fully usable offline: coming soon.
emploiDuTemps.s2: The timetable can be printed or saved as a PDF: it can be read without a projector, class by class.
emploiDuTemps.s3: Without a phone, students read their timetable on screen or on paper. Changes are announced by notification and by email, nothing else.

presences.s1: Attendance is taken on the website: it needs a connection. There is no offline attendance.
presences.s2: Attendance by hand is taken on the session's list, with no projector. The QR code, on the other hand, is projected.
presences.s3: By hand, the teacher marks each student present, late or absent: no phone needed. The QR code requires the student's app.

espaceDeCours.s1: You need an internet connection to open course links and answer polls. Document uploads: coming soon.
espaceDeCours.s2: Students can open course links and answer polls on their own devices, with no projector needed.
espaceDeCours.s3: Students can use an internet-connected computer to open course links and answer polls using their own accounts.

quizEtJeux.s1: In a self-paced quiz, each answer is saved immediately: a dropped connection loses nothing. The live quiz and the games need a connection.
quizEtJeux.s2: A self-paced quiz opens with a link, a code or a QR code, with no projector. The live quiz is shown on a projected screen.
quizEtJeux.s3: A quiz is played in any browser, but each student answers from a device. The Linux terminal is played at the board: the teacher types the command.

annoncesEtMessages.s1: An attachment's size is shown before you open it. The app only keeps the last dashboard and weeks viewed: offline, an announcement cannot be read. The app fully usable offline: coming soon.
annoncesEtMessages.s2: An announcement is read on each person's screen; it cannot be printed from Planner.
annoncesEtMessages.s3: An announcement arrives as a notification in the app and, optionally, by email. Without a phone or email, the student does not receive it.
